description_en: Queries the details of a class by calling GetClassDetail. You can use this operation to query the class status and the IDs of associated resources such as live streaming, co-streaming, and whiteboard. You can use these IDs to further query the details of the corresponding live streaming, co-streaming, and whiteboard resources
description_zh: 调用GetClassDetail获取课程详情。可用于查询课程状态，以及相关联的直播，连麦，白板等ID信息。通过这些ID，可进一步查询对应的直播，连麦，白板的详情
kebab_example: aliyun imp get-class-detail --app-id 7m000q --class-id A55-0000-Y34O --user-id as0000hs --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetClassDetail

parameters.help_en: The application ID of the user, which is generated when the application is created in the console. The ID consists of lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the class, which is returned by the CreateClass operation
parameters.help_zh: 课程唯一标识，由调用CreateClass返回
parameters.name: class_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the operator. The ID can contain only letters and digits and is up to 36 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 操作人用户ID，仅支持英文字母和数字，长度最多36个字符
parameters.name: user_id
